summary: display: flex lays out an element's children in a row (or column). justify-content spaces them along the row, align-items lines them up across it, and gap adds space between them.
notes: justify-content: space-between puts the first item at the start, the last at the end, and spreads the extra space between.
flex-wrap: wrap lets items move to a new line when the row is full. Without it they shrink to fit.
flex: 1 1 120px lets each card grow to share the leftover width equally.
pitfall: Expecting align-items: center to center items left to right. In a row, justify-content controls left to right and align-items controls top to bottom.
